tool_activity.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---' && rg --files -g '"'!*__pycache__*'"' . && printf '%s\\n' '--- TASK.md ---' && sed -n '1,240p' TASK.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- materials files ---' && rg --files materials"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,260p' materials/dsl/README.md && sed -n '1,320p' materials/dsl/core.md && sed -n '1,360p' materials/dsl/types-numerics-and-effects.md && sed -n '1,280p' materials/programming-model/kernel-and-host.md && sed -n '1,260p' materials/programming-model/logical-program.md && sed -n '1,180p' materials/vector_add.py && printf '%s\\n' '--- current candidate ---' && sed -n '1,240p' candidate.py && printf '%s\\n' '--- response schema ---' && sed -n '1,120p' response-schema.json"

/bin/bash -c "nl -ba candidate.py && printf '%s\\n' '--- exact arg_reduce docs/context ---' && rg -n -C 20 \"arg_reduce\" materials/dsl/core.md materials/dsl/types-numerics-and-effects.md materials/programming-model/*.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- relevant type/cast docs ---' && rg -n -C 12 \"cast|tuple|rank-zero|scalar|index dtype|logical index|stored/scattered\" materials/dsl/core.md materials/dsl/types-numerics-and-effects.md"
